title: Finite element approximation of the enthalpy formulation for Stefan problems on evolving surfaces
summary: We propose, and analyse, a spatially discrete evolving surface finite element method for the approximation of the enthalpy formulation of the two-phase Stefan problem posed on an evolving surface. Our approach does not rely on mass-lumping and discrete maximum principles. We prove this numerical method is numerically stable, and prove $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{h})$ error bounds for the temperature in the $L^2_{L^2}$ norm under minimal regularity assumptions by introducing a new projection-type operator.
